VenuePage.title: Venue
VenuePage.heroImageAlt: Rosewood Estate, Napa Valley — the wedding venue
VenuePage.aboutText: Rosewood Estate is a stunning 40-acre vineyard estate in the heart of Napa Valley. With its sweeping rose garden ceremony lawn, grand pavilion reception hall, and breathtaking views of the vineyards, it's the perfect backdrop for Emma and James's celebration. The estate has hosted weddings for over 25 years.
